question: Which specific goddess forms constitute the divisions of Tārā in this classification?
premises: The verse refers to divisions of Tārā.
These divisions are specified by name.
The named forms are Ugra-tārā, Ekajaṭā, and Nīla-sarasvatī.
inference: The divisions of Tārā are Ugra-tārā, Ekajaṭā, and Nīla-sarasvatī.
plain_english: The divisions of Tārā are thus: Ugra-tārā, Ekajaṭā, and Nīla-sarasvatī.
